invariants.description: Elapsed time, not rendered frames, determines burning
A hidden/click-through app must remain recoverable
Missing/stale evidence never satisfies a completion gate
Burning sessions and text are local, bounded and recoverable

checks.description: TypeScript compiler and core tests execute
Production Vite build succeeds with locked dependencies
Windows native build and startup smoke succeed

requirements.title: Durable scope, evidence and safe resume

checks.description: All sources and invariants mapped
Fresh process resumes and rejects stale evidence/missing checks
Light, burn, extinguish and finish transitions with elapsed wall time
Real browser can set wish, light incense and see rendered changes

requirements.title: Bounded local state and robust recovery

checks.description: Malformed, future or oversized persisted values cannot corrupt the ritual
Browser reload restores the correct burning session
Native file persistence survives app restart
Consecutive and asynchronous overlapping saves preserve the newest snapshot; failures are visible and retryable
Compact/expanded layout, drag, pin, hide, tray recovery and quit work
Click-through reaches a real underlay and tray restores interactivity
Window remains recoverable with changed monitor/DPI layout
No remote assets, arbitrary shell/filesystem access, secret or deployment integration
Invalid native input is rejected; state writes are bounded and serialized
Hidden or idle scenes stop continuous drawing; reduced motion respected
Target-machine CPU/memory profile distinguishes software rendering
Keyboard controls, focus, accessible labels and responsive layouts
Build/test commands and evidence boundaries documented honestly
Independent reviewer checks current implementation; findings dispositioned
